description: The plot illustrates the training loss over iterations for different configurations of the SepLLM model, compared to a baseline “Vanilla before post-training” model. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” spans from 95,000 to 125,000 in linear scale with major tick marks every 5,000 iterations. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.0 to 3.0 in linear scale with major ticks every 0.2 units. Four distinct lines are shown: a pink solid line for “SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)” starts near 3.0 at 95,000 iterations and steadily declines to approximately 2.25 by 125,000; a dark blue solid line for “SepLLM (n=128)” begins slightly below 3.0 and decreases to about 2.3; an orange solid line for “SepLLM (n=64)” starts near 3.0 and drops to roughly 2.35; and a red dashed horizontal line for “Vanilla before post-training” remains constant at approximately 2.35 across all iterations. All SepLLM variants show a consistent downward trend in loss, with the pink line (n=64, larger lr) achieving the lowest final loss, while the vanilla baseline remains flat, indicating no improvement during this phase.
